verdicts.reason: A keeps the original order (logo, can, headline, copy, CTA), but the SOLSTICE wordmark runs into the green circle, the gaps between can, headline and body copy are uneven and wide, the body copy is small, and the CTA nearly touches the side edges. B breaks the hierarchy: the headline sits above the brand wordmark and over the green circle, the logo is stuck between headline and copy, and the can is pushed below the copy, so the order is jumbled and the stack looks arbitrary, even though its CTA is better proportioned.
